title: Tiếng Anh 11: Global Success & Lifelong Learning (SGK Kết nối tri thức)
sourceNote: Nội dung biên soạn bám sát chuẩn kiến thức SGK Tiếng Anh 11 Global Success - Bộ sách Kết nối tri thức với cuộc sống.

lessons.title: Global Warming & Present Perfect Continuous
guidance: Global warming is caused by greenhouse gas emissions trapping heat in the Earth's atmosphere.
Present Perfect Continuous: S + have/has + been + V-ing.
Usage: Emphasizes the duration or ongoing nature of an action that started in the past and continues to the present, or has just stopped with present results.
examples: Scientists have been studying climate change for decades.
They have been cutting down forests, which increases carbon dioxide levels.

questions.prompt: Which grammar form is the Present Perfect Continuous tense?
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous uses have/has + been + V-ing.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The temperature ____ rising steadily for the past few years.
questions.explanation: 'For the past few years' indicates an ongoing action starting in the past -> has been rising.

questions.prompt: Which of the following actions directly contributes to deforestation?

options.text: Cutting down trees for timber and agriculture
Planting new saplings in urban parks

questions.explanation: Deforestation means clearing forests or cutting down trees on a large scale.

lessons.title: Independent Life & To-Infinitive Clauses
guidance: To-infinitive clauses (to + V) can be used after certain adjectives (it is important to do...) and nouns (the decision to leave...).
Key skills for teenager independence: time management, self-care, decision making, and problem solving.
examples: It is necessary to learn how to cook for yourself.
She has the ability to manage her own budget wisely.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: It is important for teenagers ____ time management skills.
questions.explanation: Structure: It is + adj + (for sb) + to-V.

questions.prompt: Which adjective means 'able to rely on oneself without needing help from others'?
Choose the correct sentence combining: She made a plan. She wanted to complete the project on time.

options.text: She made a plan to complete the project on time.
She made a plan completing the project on time.
She made a plan completed the project on time.

questions.explanation: Use a to-infinitive clause to express purpose or modify the noun 'plan'.

lessons.title: ASEAN Community & Gerunds / Participle Clauses
guidance: ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) promotes economic growth, cultural exchange, and regional stability.
Gerunds (V-ing) function as nouns (subject, object of preposition).
Participle clauses (V-ing / V-ed) reduce relative clauses to make sentences concise.
examples: Joining ASEAN in 1995 helped Viet Nam integrate into the regional economy.
Countries located in Southeast Asia cooperate closely.

questions.prompt: Viet Nam became an official member of ASEAN in which year?
questions.explanation: Viet Nam joined ASEAN on July 28, 1995.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct gerund form: ____ in community activities helps students build teamwork skills.
questions.explanation: Gerund (V-ing) acts as the subject of the sentence.

questions.prompt: Reduce the clause: 'Students who study abroad gain cultural experience.' -> 'Students ____ abroad gain cultural experience.'
questions.explanation: Active relative clause reduces to Present Participle (V-ing).

lessons.title: Preserving Heritage Sites & Cleft Sentences
guidance: Cleft sentences (It is/was ... that ...) are used to emphasize a specific part of a sentence (subject, object, or adverbial).
Heritage preservation protects cultural landscapes, ancient monuments, and intangible traditions for future generations.
examples: It was in Ha Long Bay that we saw beautiful limestone islands.
It is youth enthusiasm that helps promote local traditions.

questions.prompt: Which structure represents a Cleft Sentence used for emphasis?

options.text: It is / was + [emphasized part] + that + [rest of sentence]

questions.explanation: Cleft sentence structure: It is/was ... that ...

questions.prompt: Emphasize the subject: 'The local government restored the ancient citadel.'

options.text: It was the local government that restored the ancient citadel.
The ancient citadel was restored by local government.
Local government had restored ancient citadel.

questions.explanation: It was + [the local government] + that + restored...

questions.prompt: Intangible cultural heritage includes which of the following?

options.text: Folk music, traditional festivals, and craftsmanship

questions.explanation: Intangible heritage consists of non-physical traditions and living expressions.

lessons.title: Education Pathways & Vocational Training
guidance: High school graduates can choose higher education (universities/colleges) or vocational training pathways.
Key vocabulary: higher education, vocational school, qualification, tuition fee, career prospects.
examples: Vocational education provides practical hands-on skills for immediate employment.

questions.prompt: Which term refers to education that prepares students for a specific skilled trade or job?
questions.explanation: Vocational training focuses on practical skills for specific careers.

questions.prompt: Choose the word with different stress pattern: university, qualification, degree, graduation.
questions.explanation: degree /dɪˈɡriː/ is stressed on the 2nd syllable, others on 3rd/4th.

questions.prompt: Complete: Many students apply for ____ to help pay their university tuition fees.
questions.explanation: Scholarships provide financial aid for study.
